title: Workbook of Cleft and Counter
summary: Pairs each of a Ruler's great cleaving cuts with a counter that answers the blow that follows it.

title: River-Basin Axe Drill-Book

title: Wind-Sworn Handbook of the Plateau Axe

title: Treatise on Bearing the Gale Cleave

title: Canon of the Windward Hew
summary: Teaches a Ruler to hew into the wind, so that the headwind steadies the swing and the cut meets it with force.

title: Oath-Bearing Axe Canon
